name: PV Maine Solar
old_description: Welcome to PV Maine, your local experts in solar panel installation across Downeast Maine and every county in the state. We specialize in custom solar energy solutions for homes and businesses, helping you save money, reduce your carbon footprint, and harness the power of the sun—even through Maine’s unique seasons.
about:
PV Maine Solar is a solar installation company based in Bar Harbor, Maine, serving customers across the state from Hancock County to Aroostook. The company focuses on residential and commercial solar projects, as well as battery storage and EV charging installations. No founding year or ownership details are publicly disclosed.

The firm designs and installs custom solar energy systems, including rooftop and ground-mounted arrays, off-grid solutions, and battery backup systems. Its services cover the full project lifecycle: consultation, system design, installation, activation, and ongoing maintenance. The company does not disclose facility size, headcount, or annual installation volumes.

PV Maine Solar works primarily with homeowners and businesses throughout Maine. Its residential clients seek to reduce electricity costs and carbon footprints, while commercial customers aim to improve sustainability and lower operating expenses. The company emphasizes its statewide reach and familiarity with Maine’s climate and incentive programs.

The company cites its local expertise, experienced installation teams, use of high-quality equipment from trusted manufacturers, competitive pricing with financing options, and a commitment to customer service as key differentiators. It positions itself as a guide through the entire solar adoption process, from initial assessment to long-term system support.
